narration:0:1360222001:0.text: With Soren and Shakir holding the fort in the desert, everything is on the right track.
narration:0:1360222001:0.source_cn: 沙漠的事情交付给索恩与沙奎尔，暂时可以放心。
narration:0:1360222001:0.male: With Soren and Shakir holding the fort in the desert, everything is on the right track.
narration:0:1360222001:0.female: With Soren and Shakir holding the fort in the desert, everything is on the right track.

narration:1:1360222002:1.text: Suddenly, Chippy fishes out a letter.
narration:1:1360222002:1.male: Suddenly, Chippy fishes out a letter.
narration:1:1360222002:1.female: Suddenly, Chippy fishes out a letter.

say:4:1360223001:1.text: Magister, a letter from Temesia just got here! They've encountered something strange too!
say:4:1360223001:1.source_cn: 主人，特弥希娅刚刚写信过来，说，他们也遇到了奇怪的事情！
say:4:1360223001:1.male: Magister, a letter from Temesia just got here! They've encountered something strange too!
say:4:1360223001:1.female: Magister, a letter from Temesia just got here! They've encountered something strange too!

say:5:1360223002:1.text: Indeed, the rift next to the Sun Temple is the most vulnerable spot if the Hypogeans ever launch an attack.
say:5:1360223002:1.source_cn: 是哦，要说恶魔，日神殿旁边的深渊裂隙才是最危险的。
say:5:1360223002:1.male: Indeed, the rift next to the Sun Temple is the most vulnerable spot if the Hypogeans ever launch an attack.
say:5:1360223002:1.female: Indeed, the rift next to the Sun Temple is the most vulnerable spot if the Hypogeans ever launch an attack.

say:6:1360223003:1.text: If Berial goes after that place...
say:6:1360223003:1.source_cn: 如果贝利尔对那边下手的话……
say:6:1360223003:1.male: If Berial goes after that place...
say:6:1360223003:1.female: If Berial goes after that place...

say:7:1360223004:1.text: Let's head to the Sun Temple right away, Magister!
say:7:1360223004:1.source_cn: 我们尽快回去日神殿看看吧，主人！
say:7:1360223004:1.male: Let's head to the Sun Temple right away, Magister!
say:7:1360223004:1.female: Let's head to the Sun Temple right away, Magister!

say:9:1360224001:1.text: You find Temesia and Lucius already waiting when you arrive at the Sun Temple.
say:9:1360224001:1.source_cn: 你们来到日神殿周边，特弥希娅与卢修斯已经等在了那里。

say:10:1360224002:1.text: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.
say:10:1360224002:1.male: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.
say:10:1360224002:1.female: It's been so long, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Even though I'm far away, I've heard all about your glorious adventures.

say:11:1360224003:1.text: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.
say:11:1360224003:1.source_cn: 这次打扰，也是因为发现了些许异常，所以希望请你来评估一下。
say:11:1360224003:1.male: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.
say:11:1360224003:1.female: I don't mean to disturb you, but an unusual phenomenon has occurred here, and I need your help to assess the situation.

say:12:1360224004:1.text: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.
say:12:1360224004:1.source_cn: 事情是这样的，我前些日子回归圣堂叙职，途中路过此处，恰...
say:12:1360224004:1.male: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.
say:12:1360224004:1.female: The other day, while heading to the temple, I passed by this place and heard some acolytes singing hymns.

say:13:1360224005:1.text: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.
say:13:1360224005:1.source_cn: 你知道，我是唱诗班出身，所以对圣歌非常的熟悉，那两位的...
say:13:1360224005:1.male: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.
say:13:1360224005:1.female: As you know, I used to be in a choir, so I'm quite familiar with hymns. It's obvious to me that the two acolytes were singing off-key.

say:14:1360224006:1.text: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.
say:14:1360224006:1.source_cn: 唱歌走调并不是什么大问题，但，他们居然还在嘻嘻哈哈。
say:14:1360224006:1.male: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.
say:14:1360224006:1.female: It's fine that their singing wasn't perfect, but the thing is, they were laughing and fooling around.

say:15:1360224007:1.text: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.
say:15:1360224007:1.source_cn: 这就是极大的不尊重了。
say:15:1360224007:1.male: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.
say:15:1360224007:1.female: I'd say that's an act of blasphemy.

say:16:1360224008:1.text: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.
say:16:1360224008:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅让我也一起确认，我对音准的把握不算很准确，但也...
say:16:1360224008:1.male: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.
say:16:1360224008:1.female: Temesia had me listen to them too. I might not have a perfect pitch, but I can definitely tell they were way off-key.

say:17:1360224009:1.text: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.
say:17:1360224009:1.source_cn: 只是，她坚持说自己听到了修士们对走调不以为然甚至引以为...
say:17:1360224009:1.male: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.
say:17:1360224009:1.female: She insists the acolytes were laughing at their own singing, but I didn't hear that.

say:18:1360224010:1.text: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.
say:18:1360224010:1.source_cn: 更奇怪的是，当我们去斥责他们的时候，他们坚持说没有任何发现。
say:18:1360224010:1.male: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.
say:18:1360224010:1.female: The weirdest part is that when we confronted them, they claimed there was nothing wrong with their singing.

say:19:1360224011:1.text: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.
say:19:1360224011:1.source_cn: 这两位就是当事人，因为感觉不太对劲，所以我暂时让他们在...
say:19:1360224011:1.male: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.
say:19:1360224011:1.female: Here they are—the singing acolytes. I asked them to wait here so they can give you their accounts.

say:21:1360224012:1.text: Temesia takes you to meet the acolytes, both of whom look aggrieved.
say:21:1360224012:1.source_cn: 在特弥希娅的引领下，你们看到了两位修士，他们都一脸委屈。

say:22:1360224013:1.text: Eager to explain themselves, the acolytes start prattling on as soon as you ask them about the situation.
say:22:1360224013:1.source_cn: 二人显然也忍耐了许久，一被问起，就立刻滔滔不绝地辩解起来。

say:23:1360224014:1.text: I-I really have no idea what Dame Temesia is talking about.
say:23:1360224014:1.source_cn: 我、我真的不知道特弥希娅圣骑士在说什么。

say:24:1360224015:1.text: Alright, I'm not a perfect singer, but I always sing hymns with the deepest devotion!
say:24:1360224015:1.source_cn: 好吧，我不能保证我的音准一定不会出错，但是在唱圣歌的时...

say:25:1360224016:1.text: I know Dura's watching, so there's no way I'd make a mockery of hymns!
say:25:1360224016:1.source_cn: 在艾雅的见证下，我怎么可能会拿圣歌取乐，甚至还嘻嘻哈哈？

say:26:1360224017:1.text: Just like Dame Temesia, I was once in a choir too. I may not be as experienced as her, but I've trained for much longer!
say:26:1360224017:1.source_cn: 别说嘻嘻哈哈了，我也是唱诗班出身，虽然不如特弥希娅圣骑...

say:27:1360224018:1.text: I'm quite confident to say I'm pitch-perfect. Throughout my life, my singing has never been off-key!
say:27:1360224018:1.source_cn: 我可以保证，我就是唱诗班的音准，长这么大，我的歌声从来...

say:29:1360224019:1.text: So, here's the deal—I'm sure I heard them laugh, and both Lucius and I heard their off-key singing.
say:29:1360224019:1.source_cn: 事情就是这样，我肯定听到了笑声，我和卢修斯都听到了跑调。

say:30:1360224020:1.text: But the acolytes don't seem to be lying either.
say:30:1360224020:1.source_cn: 但这两位兄弟姐妹也并不像说谎。

say:31:1360224021:1.text: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.
say:31:1360224021:1.source_cn: 考虑到这里临近深渊裂隙，所以我以防万一，就写信邀请了你...
say:31:1360224021:1.male: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.
say:31:1360224021:1.female: We have to be careful since we're close to the rift, so I invited you here. Didn't expect you to show up this quickly.

say:32:1360224022:1.text: Well, Magister happens to be dealing with similar issues in other places!
say:32:1360224022:1.source_cn: 因为呀，主人正在为了处理这系列的事务在奔波呢！

say:33:1360224023:1.text: We've got this, Temesia. Magister now has a weapon specially for this!
say:33:1360224023:1.source_cn: 放心吧，特弥希娅，主人现在有着专用武器！

narration:34:1360225001:1.text: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.
narration:34:1360225001:1.male: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.
narration:34:1360225001:1.female: Before the flustered crowd, you infuse magic into Dunlingr's bell.

narration:36:1360225002:1.text: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...
narration:36:1360225002:1.male: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...
narration:36:1360225002:1.female: The bell tolls, and light falls once again...

say:38:1360226001:2.text: As light blankets the land, everyone snaps out of a trance.
say:38:1360226001:2.source_cn: 随着光芒的笼罩，众人都露出了如梦方醒的神色。

say:40:1360226002:1.text: Horrendous figures of Hypofiends begin to emerge from the shadows around them...
say:40:1360226002:1.source_cn: 从他们身周的阴影中，浮现出了扭曲的魔物——

say:42:1360226003:1.text: The Hypogeans are indeed behind this!
